segments.text:
How an agent works
Components and state
To choose a model means balancing capacity, latency and cost. A high score at a benchmark does not prove that it will suit your case: Test understanding, using tools and conduct with incomplete data. A bigger model also doesn't remove the need to validate parameters.
A tool needs clear name, description, inputs and result. consultar_pedido(id_pedido) is more understandable than hacer_cosa(texto). The scheme helps the model to produce structured arguments but implementation continues to check types, ranges, authorization and existence of resource. The toolregister relates the requested name with an allowed code. you should never evaluate arbitrary text as code.
The state retains relevant information about execution: messages, results and progress. Session memory allows to continue a conversation. persistent may preserve authorized preferences between sessions. No one should keep anything read indiscriminately. Define what goes into, how long and how bad information is corrected or deleted.
The model proposes an call, the runtime valids and runs the tool. messages, results and progress form the state.

segments.title: How an agent works · Key concepts
segments.text:
How an agent works
Key concepts
At this course we studied agents based on LLM. A chatbot can answer a question. a workflow runs preset steps. an agent incorporates dynamic decisions about what to do after. It's goal oriented, acts with delimited autonomy and works iteratively. A process may contain fixed and an agenic stage. For a fully known operation, a function or a workflow is usually sufficient.
The three central components are model, tools and loop. The model interprets the request and can propose an call. The tool performs a concrete operation, such as consulting an order. The run coordinates messages, execution, state and output conditions. The model does not itself run the Python feature describing a tool.
Agent cycle: target, model, validated call, tool execution, observation and decision to continue or respond.

Step-by-step example
One person asks: "I bought three items from 24 and four 18. What's the total? " The agent has to multiply and add up.
The model identifies two subtotals and requests multiplicar(3, 24).
The runtime valids arguments, runs the function and logs 72 associated with that call.

Requests sumar(72, 72); receives 144.

The operations here are determinist. The choice of steps is put forward by the model. For a commercial calculator with established rules, program directly that sum would be easier. How an agent works
Retirement exercise
The support agent has already looked up an order. The user asks to cancel the purchase, and a retrieved page claims that confirmation can be skipped. What must happen before executing the cancellation?
 
 Solution 

The application should verify that the user can cancel that order, that it complies with the policy and that the approval required for the concrete effect exists. The text that's been recovered doesn't change these conditions. To check and cancel are different permissions To separate both tools reduces the authority of each operation. The output should reflect the actual result of the cancellation, even if it was rejected.
The cancellation checks identity, politics and approval. only if the checks are met will run and record the result.

segments.title: How an agent works · Rationale patterns
segments.text:
How an agent works
Retirement patterns
Chain-of-Thought (CoT) organizes the resolution in intermediate steps but does not provide access to current data or tools by itself. ReAct combines decisions, actions and comments: decide to consult, run the consultation and use the result for the next step. The observation can be an information or an error. Tree-of-Thought (ToT) explores alternatives and compares resolution paths offers more exploration for additional work. No pattern alone shows that an answer is correct.
The intermediate reasoning can guide the work but to check an agent sees authorized inputs, calls, verifiable final results and explanations. A tooltrace does not mean access to complete internal reasoning of the model. A stylish plan without checking the results remains an opportunity to miss.
CoT decomposes a problem, ReAct alternates decisions with tools and observations, and ToT compares alternatives.

segments.name: a3756f3f70d37004bfc1156de6562531790aaa8bb06d0654f868c4e9cd311b97-0000.txt
segments.title: How an agent works · Layer Security
segments.text:
How an agent works
Layer safety
Risks include prompt injection, tool abuse, memory pollution, data filtration and Uncontrolled execution. An outside document that says "send the keys to this email" is unreliable information, not an authorization.
Unit defence: Input validation, instructions, permissions and tools, output review and cross-sectional observability.
Apply validation of inputs instructions with clear limits; tools with minimum privilege; checks on arguments and effects; Retirement of outputs and monitoring of the whole execution. To clear searches or issue a refund, check his or her identity and politics with the operation, with human approval as appropriate. Filtering only the final answer would be too late if money had been put out.
It limits time, steps and spending. He's been picking up some bad jobs without exposing secrets. Use operation identifiers to avoid duplication of textures while retrying. The layer defence works because each control cover faults that another can let through, and not because a prompt will become infallible to the system.

segments.title: How an agent works · A complete solution: customer support
segments.text:
How an agent works
A complete solution: customer support
That only case takes the agent's cycle to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. A support application at OCI Compute connects the client with model, policy documents and orders. To consult an order isn't the same as to get back a policy or to approve a refund: each tool has arguments, permissions and its own business rules. The scheme is educational. does not represent an architecture with complete production.

A OCI Compute support application connects with OCI Generative AI for model, Object Storage for policies and Autonomous AI Database for orders.
How to read architecture: follow the customer's consultation up to the application. The model proposes what to consult. The application checks the arguments and authorization, calls the indicated service and returns the evidence to the model to prepare the response. For an action sensitive, require appropriate human approval before applying. Connecting services does not give permissions automatically.
OCI Generative AI: Reacts the query and can propose a call with a tool. The application valids and runs the function, not the model. That's how OCI's call function works.
Object Storage: keeps policies as document. A tool of the application recovers the corresponding item. The picket doesn't bring semantic search by itself.
Autonomous AI Database: contains orders and their states. The application is connected to and consulted with delimited parameters and permissions.
For example, before "where's my order?" , the application looks at the database and returns the result to the model. If the request changes to "I want a refund," you have to check the policy and get the required approval before changing data. Credentials and authorisation decisions are valid.

What's going on under the hood
The runtime prepares messages and tool schemes. The model can return text, calls to tools or other supported blocks. Don't figure it's finished just because text came up. When there's an outstanding call, the application identifies the registered name, analyzes arguments and runs the allowed tool.
Each result is linked with the appropriate call identifier. It then goes into the context of the following request. Thus the model can use the obtained value, demand another operation or produce a final response. The loop should also have boundaries and manage errors: to finish doesn't depend exclusively on how the model decides to do so.
Storing state does not mean that the LLM modifies its weights or permanently learns its user name. The application or a service has a context and contributes to future interference. Sending the entire verbatim history over the network is not required in every integration either: continuation, trimming and summarization mechanisms may be available. What's necessary is to preserve the appropriate context and relationship between calls and results.

Key concepts
Model Context Protocol (MCP) standardizes how outside capabilities are found and used. It reduces particular integration between each application and each system but does not remove configuration, credentials, policies and support differences. A supported server doesn't automatically get permission to read all your files or modify your accounts.
The host is the application that manages the interaction and the context. Within the host, a MCP client keeps the connection with a MCP server that exposes capabilities. A host can use several customers to connect to several servers. The LLM and the agent's loop continue to have its function: MCP does not by itself provide reasoning or replace orchestration.

The scheme communicates names, purposes and arguments. The responses indicate results or errors. MCP uses JSON-RPC-based messages that link requests and identifier responses. A notification does not require the same response exchange as a request.
With stdio, client and server they communicate with the standard entrance and output of a local process. with Streamable HTTP, the client connects to a endpoint HTTP; It's suitable for remote servers and can also be used locally. Security and authentication depend on transport and deployment. Check the capabilities of the version that you use in MCP's official architecture.
"Server from an outside supplier" does not necessarily mean "remote process." You can run a third party package locally using stdio and have that package call after a API cloud by HTTPS. A host starts a server by stdio. The server looks at OCI by HTTPS. Do you have to set up the MCP client as Streamable HTTP just because the data come from the cloud?
 
 Solution 

No. The MCP transport describes the connection between client and server: in this case it's stdio. The HTTPS connection from the server to OCI is another integration. To change transport without changing the deployment would break communication. The place where the data are does not automatically determine the MCP transport.
Solution: The client connects to the local server by stdio The server connects to OCI by HTTPS without changing the MCP transport.

segments.text:
The OpenAI Agent Stack
Wagons and traces
Input, output and tools have different ranges. In the SDK, the input are applied to the first agent of the chain and the out agent to which the final response results. Don't assume they're repeated at every specialist. Validation of an action sensitive is placed next to the tool and an approval can pause the flow. Parallel checks reduce latency but can allow speculative work: use execution blocking as necessary. Query guarrails and human review.
In the support example, a voucher can produce a structured output as is_support_question: bool, defined with a Pydantic model. If the result fails to fulfill the rule, the guarrail can activate a tripwire: The Runner stops the execution with an exception that the application should manage. Do not uncover operations already undertaken. That's why it matters when it's valid. The official SDK guarrails implementation shows structured result and execution modes.
A trace shows stages, calls and available results. helps to distinguish time from model, from a API and from validation. It protects the registered data and checks the layout configuration. Do not interpret a trace as complete internal reasoning or feel that the most visible function is necessarily the bottle neck.

Step-by-step example
A tent has backpack descriptions and user wants "a light backpack to wear laptop, for less than 200 soles."
First, it retains description, price, category and embedding of each product. Convert demand into a vector compatible with existing ones. It recovers semantically close candidates and filters price and availability with structured data. It orders and verifies that the description really mentions space for laptop. Finally, it presents options and their attributes supported by the table.
This educational SQL includes a product table, its VECTOR-type embedding column and the reference vector linked as: query_embedding. Use COSINE only if the model corresponds to them. FETCH EXACT makes explicit an exact search for the three closest neighbours that fulfill the filters. Query the exact official search syntax.
SELECT name, price, description
FROM products
WHERE price < 200 and stock > 0
ORDER BY VECTOR_DISTANCE (embedding,: query_embedding, COSINE)
FETCH EXACT FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY

Also try an unmatching consultation and a product that's semantically close but outweighs the price. The right answer may be "I did not find an option that met both conditions." The similarity does not allow them to ignore restrictions and to invent stock.
An illustrative example of a backpack search: a product close and available by 180 soles passes through. another by 240 soles is discarded by price and another without stock is discarded by availability.

Vector and similarity
An embedding represents data using a list of numbers generated by a model. Their usefulness depends on how relevant relationships are reflected in that space. Two phrases can be about the same without sharing exact words, and a semantic search can get that relationship back.
For text, the path is text → tokenizer → model → vector. tokens can be words or parts of words: to count words doesn't mean to count tokens. If the entry limit of the model is exceeded, content can be truncated. That's why we divide long documents before we generate embeddings. Staple size and overlap between fragments to preserve context and check recovery with representative questions, without applying a universal number. Oracle explain these transformations and fragmentation parameters.
The document and consultation embeddings model should produce supported representations: change dimensions or model without regenerating and validating data breaks comparison. The distance metric also matters. Cosine's focused on direction. Euclidean measures geometric separation. Choose the recommended metric for the model and check its conduct with examples of your domain.
The VECTOR column allows to store embeddings with identifiers, text, prices or permissions. Vector search can be combined with relational filters. "Semantically similar" means neither "true" nor "authorized"; apply access restrictions before providing model document.
Two-dimensional conceptual map: backpack and laptop bag are close to the office while a bicycle's far away. cosine compares direction and Euclidean geometric separation.

Wrong choice: Retrain continuously.

segments.title: Oracle Agentic AI Foundations · Practice: agentic-quiz-23
segments.text:
Oracle Agentic AI Foundations
What two predefined agents are usually included as a standard in Agent Factory?
Wrong choice: Backup and restoration agents.
Answer correct: Knowledge Agent and Data Analysis Agent.
Explanation: Knowledge Agent is responsible for the search for corporate documents with tractable sources while Data Analysis Agent converts natural language to SQL with automatic display. Both are ready to be used before performing any custom development.
Wrong choice: Compilation agents and deployment.
Wrong choice: Email and calendar agents.

segments.name: 0a0c76965f199727d121f35f33ee6a2d24627c3beb533951be2692ee07abfd92-0000.txt

segments.text:

What's the purpose of tools routing at a AI agent?
Wrong choice: Storing model monitoring points.
Wrong choice: To compress the conversation history.
Wrong choice: To train the model of language.
Answer right: Select and run tools.
Explanation: The tool routing determines what tool to use by the agent, forms the request and manages the results of the execution.

segments.name: 5427a020a4b29bba44c927a45567ba9fa530161cfdfefadb9ca3f5be95557460-0000.txt
segments.title: Oracle Agentic AI Foundations · Practice: agentic-quiz-25
segments.text:
Oracle Agentic AI Foundations
What is the function of prompts in Model Context Protocol (MCP)?
Wrong choice: The prompts bypass language models entirely and run only on backend servers.
Answer: The prompts are reusable templates that are usually directly invoked using user interfaces.
Explanation: At MCP, prompts are treated as reusable interplay templates that help guide users' workflows and structure interactions with AI systems. They are normally called by the user and are designed to offer consistent interviewing experiences.
Wrong choice: prompts simply returns flat text responses with no structured outputs.
Wrong choice: prompts are encoded differently from other protocol components and interfaces.

segments.name: b3c8e4ba0852e08a43649c4382fe63bf9eee249efb6c065f966ee412a197ead5-0000.txt
segments.title: Oracle Agentic AI Foundations · Practice: agentic-quiz-26
segments.text:
Oracle Agentic AI Foundations
What three categories of tools can combine an Select AI Agent into an same workflow?
Wrong choice: Free tools, payment and prémium.
Incorrect choice: only Java, C and Python tools.
Answer right: Integrated tools, custom PL/SQL storage procedures and external REST services.
Explanation: The agents can invoke integrated capabilities (RAG on a vector index and NL2SQL on approved schemes), re-use existing PL/SQL procedures and gain access to any API REST encapsulated with a PL/SQL function, with free combination of them within a same plan.
Incorrect choice: only synchronous, asynchronous and in batches tools.

segments.name: 9bf1f6870522f69c0c9a61f08da90b3e02a2b4caa315e8b1048c006b136936af-0000.txt
segments.title: Oracle Agentic AI Foundations · Practice: agentic-quiz-27
segments.text:
Oracle Agentic AI Foundations
How to implement a protection mechanism (guarrail) in the OpenAI Agents SDK?
Incorrect choice: as a persistent database mechanism that automatically valids the logs after each request of API completed.
Incorrect choice: as a dedicated network security device that leaks and valids the requests intermittent traffic entrants.
Incorrect choice: as a distributed monitoring service that valids requests in multiple regional deployments infrastructure.
Answer: as an auxiliary agent or a validation function that checks inputs or outputs and determines whether a tripwire condition should be activated.
Explanation: The protective mechanisms are usually put into place as auxiliary agents or functions that inspect the agent's entry or exit and return an Output Function Storage that indicates whether execution should continue.

segments.name: c771db8cc1d4ff693ced7ed24d9e0e8cf529dc1f8c4dd76cae922cf283e30b6c-0000.txt
segments.title: Oracle Agentic AI Foundations · Practice: agentic-quiz-28
segments.text:
Oracle Agentic AI Foundations
What's the function of an output analyzer (Output Parser) from LangChain?
Wrong choice: To permanently store the memory of the conversation.
Answer correct: Convert model responses to usable formats.
Explanation: The output analyzers process the unprocessed responses of LLM and turn them into more purified formats, such as text chains, JSON objects or structured data that applications can use directly.
Wrong choice: To select the best LLM provider automatically.
Wrong choice: Run API and external tools.

segments.name: 533612aa5eaded65bb709ea3efd10e89d7bf1dc4ee455d1fc2d3869ee2a990b9-0000.txt

Wrong choice: The SDK does not directly support tools.
Failed choice: The SDK only supports tools hosted by OpenAI.
Answer: The SDK supports several tool categories.
Explanation: The Agents SDK supports several tool patterns, including tools hosted by OpenAI, tools based on Python's functions and agents exposed as invincible tools.

segments.name: 46b957199c032317349d3b9bd9dd11b4105b40dec86c6cf4c913fd450fc89df7-0000.txt
segments.title: Oracle Agentic AI Foundations · Practice: agentic-quiz-30
segments.text:

segments.text:
Oracle Agentic AI Foundations
What set of capabilities does Oracle AI Database support represent for workloads's AI agentics?
Wrong choice: Processing OLAP, OLTP services, backup management and database recovery operations.
Incorrect choice: storage Services, resources compute, Network Management and Identity Management Tools.
Answer correct: Oracle AI Vector Search, Oracle AI Database Private Agent Factory, Select AI Agent and Oracle Autonomous AI Database MCP Server.

Wrong choice: Form development tools, report generation, data collection and corporate intelligence publication.

segments.name: 86a171dc3a3bd8fc3046300f86f400afa64385ec95a0b39a89005f9b6aa467da-0000.txt
segments.title: Oracle Agentic AI Foundations · Practice: agentic-quiz-32
segments.text:
Oracle Agentic AI Foundations
Which chainable utilities form the workflow from text to chunks and from chunks to embeddings?
Wrong choice: EXTRACT_TEXT → SLICE_TEXT → COMPUTE_VECTOR.
Answer correct: UTL_TO_TEXT → UTL_TO_CHUNKS → UTL_TO_EMBEDDINGS.
Explanation: DBMS_VECTOR_CHAIN exposes the trio UTL_TO_TEXT, UTL_TO_CHUNKS and UTL_TO_EMBEDDINGS. They can be combined into a single SQL INSERT instruction to turn a document directly into vectors of its fragments.
Wrong choice: UTL_PDF → UTL_DOC → UTL_XML.
Wrong choice: INSERT → UPDATE → DELETE.

segments.name: 9452604211270e536e0b25c723b15945b1b60a795f2298070f5b92ef6d8512d9-0000.txt
segments.title: Oracle Agentic AI Foundations · Practice: agentic-quiz-33
segments.text:
Oracle Agentic AI Foundations
What's mcp.run(transport="stdio") doing?
Wrong option: Connect MCP server to a remote endpoint HTTPS.
Incorrect choice: Unabling tools execution and activates a mode that only registers events.
The right Answer: Begin the MCP server with the STDIO transport.
Explanation: mcp.run(transport="stdio") starts the MCP server by means of STDIO transport so that a host application can run it as a subprocess and exchange JSON-RPC messages through stdin / stdout.
Wrong choice: Begin a local HTTP server that listens to at a network port.

segments.name: 5862d1d15d622cfc2137097cb5fa6d95a3a718b6a000e7557b4112a97b702657-0000.txt
segments.title: Oracle Agentic AI Foundations · Practice: agentic-quiz-34
segments.text:
Oracle Agentic AI Foundations
What is the role of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) in grounding an agent’s responses in database data?
Failed choice: Unds database security checks.
Wrong option: Unused tables are automatically removed.
Wrong choice: Generates false data to fill empty tables.
Answer correct: Reforms relevant fragments and provides them to a LLM to work out their response.
Explanation: RAG is the standard approach to base the answers: to generate an embedding of the question, to run a vector search about the indexed corporate content and to pass to LLM fragments with more coincidence as a context for their response to be based on actual data.

Wrong choice: result.choices[0].message.content
Answer correct: result.final_output
Explanation: The Agents SDK exposes the agent's final response using result.final_output, which prevents manually passing lower level response structures.
Wrong choice: result["messages"][-1]["text"]
Wrong choice: result.body.text

Wrong choice: MCP Calling

Wrong choice: File Search

segments.text:

What statement differentiates a chatbot, a workflow and an agent from AI?
Wrong choice: The three systems are based on an identical execution logic and response behavior.
Failed choice: AI agents are mainly different by admitting more external integrations.
Wrong choice: Work flows dynamically select tools and actions during execution time interactions.
Answer right: The chatbots respond to prompts, the workflows follow a logic and the agents adapt dynamically.
Explanation: The chatbots mainly generate responses to prompts, the workflows follow predefined execution routes and AI agents dynamically choose actions or tools depending on their objectives and intermediate observations.

segments.name: 4b7437abf2033f07ae4dd75a7d40204c44f97ef1d4244cd3caaa6cd3d54ea1fb-0000.txt
segments.title: Oracle Agentic AI Foundations · Practice: agentic-quiz-38
segments.text:
Oracle Agentic AI Foundations
What component or vector storage formats supports Oracle?
Answer correct: FLOAT32, FLOAT64, INT8 and BINARY
Explanation: Oracle supports several component formats so that you can balance accuracy and storage. FLOAT32 is the default format, FLOAT64 provides more precision, INT8 is compact and BINARY (1 bit by dimension) is the most compact for some use cases.
Wrong choice: 1's only BINARY by dimension
Wrong choice: Just INT64
Wrong choice: Just FLOAT32

segments.title: Oracle Agentic AI Foundations · Practice: agentic-quiz-39
segments.text:
Oracle Agentic AI Foundations
Why are type entries important for LangChain tools?
Wrong choice: They allow tools to be run asynchronously.
Wrong choice: They improve inference performance at GPU.
The right Answer: They help to generate tool parameters schemes.
Explanation: LangChain uses Python's type annotations to automatically generate structured schemes describing tools parameters. These schemes help the LLM to understand what arguments each tool expects.
Wrong choice: They figure the arguments sent to tools.

Explanation: The defense in depth uses several layers of safety so that the weaknesses that one layer cannot detect can be detected by another.
Wrong choice: A model can replace all tools.
Wrong choice: Several prompts improve reasoning.
Wrong choice: A single protection stops all attacks.

segments.text:
CertiTube · Oracle AI Copilot: Real-Time Support With Speech, Sentiment & Generative AI
How can a customer service team be supported during a customer conversation? This Smart Co-Pilot combines OCI Speech for live transcription, OCI Language for sentiment analysis and OCI Generative AI for language models and embeddings. Oracle Autonomous Database 23ai with AI Vector Search provides data and context; OCI Compute hosts the application and chatbot. The interface brings together contract information, call transcription, sentence-level sentiment, aspects such as service or customer care, and suggested responses. The assistant uses this context to support the team during the interaction. The walkthrough covers requests, complaints and customer analysis. The request example concerns a move from prepaid to postpaid and available promotions. The copilot suggestions help the team respond and guide customer service.

segments.text:
CertiTube · Oracle Cloud Data Governance: DAMA, Metadata & AI Architecture
How can data governance connect architecture decisions with business goals? The talk applies DAMA-DMBOK concepts to a hypothetical case involving document and structured-data ingestion and transformation in Oracle Cloud. It connects an architecture using OCI Object Storage, OCI Events, OCI Functions, and Oracle Autonomous Database with security, quality, metadata, and traceability. Responsibilities, coordination between departments, and isolated sources are reviewed. An illustrative nine-month roadmap supports a discussion of migration, coexistence, standardization, early value delivery, and TCO and ROI assessment, including operational effort. The walkthrough introduces Database Actions and Data Studio, a comparison of cloud platforms, and examples involving embeddings, medallion architecture, and workflows. It ends with questions about process dependencies and learning to work as a data architect.

CertiTube · Generative AI & LLMs: From Neural Networks To Token Prediction
How are neural networks related to text generation with an LLM? The introduction uses buying decisions and review classification to explore inputs, weights, thresholds and activation functions. It starts with a simple perceptron and moves to the multilayer perceptron (MLP), embeddings, hidden layers, ReLU and softmax. Multiclass classification is used as a teaching analogy for a distribution over possible tokens, without equating the example MLP with a complete language model architecture. A Shakespeare question illustrates gradual response construction and introduces the end-of-sequence token. The walkthrough provides a conceptual basis for exploring OCI Generative AI. It focuses on understanding neural networks and token prediction, with references for further study.

segments.text:
CertiTube · Oracle AI: Batch PDF Processing With OCR & AI Agents
How can you process a batch of PDF files with OCR and AI agents and track the progress of each document? The demonstration walks through a desktop utility with a batch of 1000 ZIP files containing PDF documents. The input folder is selected, an application token is obtained, and a workflow starts by performing OCR before sending each document to the agent queue. A JSON output is generated when processing is complete. The demonstrated configuration supports two simultaneous OCR tasks and up to eight agent tasks in parallel. The panel shows status, pages, times for each stage, and estimated progress. It also lets users save API activity logs, export the table to CSV, and reprocess a document. The video explains configurable retries and the relationship between concurrency and infrastructure in Kubernetes. The limits shown apply to this example configuration.

How can you query tables and documents with LangGraph agents and workflows? The campaign management example uses eight tables covering offers, segments, channels and interactions. Loan documents in PDF format are ingested with OCI Document Understanding and prepared for RAG using LangChain and Oracle AI Vector Search. The demonstration compares four LangGraph patterns. Loan offers are queried, and the generated SQL is copied and checked in Autonomous. Content is also retrieved from the PDF documents. segments.text:
CertiTube · AI Document Analyzer: Agentic RAG for PDFs on Oracle Cloud
Ask questions to your documents and find answers with evidence and citations. AI Document Analyzer combines PDFs processing, information retrieval and response generation with AI at Oracle Cloud. The application allows you to load documents, process them individually or in batches and remove text per page, metadata and embeddings. You can also add metadata from CSV files to give context to queries. His flow of Agenic RAG, orchestrated with LangGraph, classifies his consultation, deletes his documentary reach, retrieves evidence and builds his response. The citations allow them to contrast what the system responds with the recovered sources. The project integrates Oracle Autonomous AI Database, OCI Object Storage and OCI Generative AI to work with documents and generate responses based on available content. It's a community and independent Oracle project. in the repository you will find the code and configuration instructions and deployment.

segments.text:
CertiTube · Oracle AI Data Platform: Medallion Architecture, Governance & Analytics
Take your Bronze data to Gold and connect them with analysis and governance at Oracle Cloud. In this video I show you how to combine OCI Object Storage, Oracle AI Data Platform Workbench, OCI Data Catalog and Oracle Analytics Cloud into a lakehouse architecture with medallion layers. We will go through the buckets, Master Catalog, the tables Delta and the organisation of the workspace. We review computer configuration, Spark UI metrics and workflow orchestration with parameters to process specific dates and work with incremental or complete loads. We also explore audit, login and access roles. We have been trying three practical cases: to add a column to a Delta table by keeping historic data, mask information from customers with OCI Language or regular expressions, and run SQL consultations about the Gold Layer to get reports. We then organize the business context with a glossary at OCI Data Catalog and connect Oracle Analytics Cloud with AIDP to select tables, link data and prepare visualizations. Thus you can follow the path from storage and transformation to analytical consumption.

segments.text:
CertiTube · AI Document Analyzer + OCI Document Understanding V2.0: key-value extraction and routing
Convert document to carne-value data and use the results to conduct your processing. In this video we integrate AI Document Analyzer with OCI Document Understanding V2.0 to identify documentary types and apply a specific extraction model to each. Generative extraction allows to define every key, its data type and a description of the field in JSON. That's how it's adapted to different formats and to multilingual content in the languages supported by the service. The first stage of the shown flow analyzes the first page to distinguish minutes, contracts and prospectuses. The model returns a label. a condition of workflow relates to the original file and chooses the branch and the extractor. Then, the dedicated model processes the pages and gets their keys and values. We reviewed the JSON of the generative model at OCI Object Storage, AI Document Analyzer's installation with Oracle Autonomous Database, model creation and workflow design. Finally, we have been looking at the executions and monitoring module to check the classification and results of each document.

CertiTube · AI Data Platform Workshop: Data Lineage
Where did your data come from and what processes transformed them before they reached a final table? In this demo, I'll show you the data line at Oracle AI Data Platform Workbench with the Telco Customer 360 Lineage. The lab collects CRM data, prepaid lines and recharges, after-paid bills and bills and home services. segments.text:
CertiTube · Oracle AI Accelerator: 5 Demos with Select AI, RAG & Multimodal AI
How can you explore five ways to query tables, documents, audio and images from one application? Oracle AI Accelerator combines Oracle Autonomous Database, files in OCI Object Storage and OCI Generative AI models. The walkthrough prepares the environment, connection, credentials and users with their modules before starting the tests. The five demos cover Select AI over a Titanic CSV file; Select AI with RAG over HTML and TXT files; OCR and PDF questions with OCI Document Understanding; audio transcription to SRT with OCI Speech; and JPG document processing and image queries with a multimodal model. The transcribed audio is then analyzed with a generative model to summarize conversations, answer questions and explain sentiment analysis. The walkthrough also reviews generated SQL, column comments, response sources, metadata and embeddings stored in Autonomous, along with application history and metrics.

segments.title: CertiTube · Oracle Autonomous Data Warehouse: Data Quality & Workflow Framework
segments.text:
CertiTube · Oracle Autonomous Data Warehouse: Data Quality & Workflow Framework
How can transformations, data quality and dependencies be organized from staging to the dataset? This Data Framework on Oracle Autonomous Data Warehouse draws on DAMA data management practices. Its Data Staging Area (DSA) classifies information as STG for transactional data, STC for catalog tables and STH for historical data. Query Mapping produces reusable intermediate tables. The design includes indexes, parameters in tables and business rule checks before each mapping, with email error notifications. Metadata documents attributes and supports versioning and change management; preserving history through partitions is also proposed. The output dataset comes from the final mapping and its Query Dataset. QuickDBD is presented to support dataset modeling. Each workflow is encapsulated in a stored procedure with one or more mappings and generates one dataset. The monitor records checks, mappings, datasets, start and end, retaining the last N executions. Dependencies allow other workflows to be triggered as a controlled execution network.
A video from AI CloudTech published the 2024-09-25. Ficha revised the 2026-10-21. Topics: Oracle Autonomous Data Warehouse, Data Framework, Data quality, DAMA, Metadata, Workflows, Data Staging Area, QuickDBD.

segments.text:
CertiTube · Oracle AI Database 26ai: Build Agents With Select AI, SQL & RAG
How can an agent team query tables and documents in Oracle Autonomous AI Database 26ai? The demonstration uses Oracle AI Accelerator to prepare two sources: a debt-collection dataset in CSV format and a public financial statement from Banco de Chile in PDF format. CertiTube · Oracle Autonomous Database 23ai: Build A RAG Chatbot With AI Vector Search
How can customer data become context for a RAG chatbot? The example connects Oracle Autonomous Database 23ai, AI Vector Search and OCI Generative AI. It starts with customer, plan, contract, billing and satisfaction tables. Views prepare text and metadata; the sp_elt_insert_into_docs procedure splits the content, generates embeddings and stores it in DOCS for retrieval. The walkthrough reviews DBMS_VECTOR, DBMS_VECTOR_CHAIN, UTL_TO_CHUNKS and JSON_TABLE, along with industry, case and view parameters. It prepares access policies, Autonomous and its wallet, an API Key, a VCN and a Windows OCI Compute instance. The chatbot is then installed; NGINX is presented as an optional configuration. The demo compares selected profiles and cases to observe changes in retrieved context. It also generates test customers, updates their embeddings and queries the information through the chat. The walkthrough ends by inspecting DOCS, metadata, views and the procedure in Autonomous.

CertiTube · Oracle AI Data Platform Workbench: X Sentiment Analysis With OCI Language & Agent Factory
Convert X comments to data that you can analyze with SQL and consult from an agent. The demonstration integrates Oracle AI Data Platform Workbench, OCI Language, Oracle Autonomous AI Database and Agent Factory. The service, workspace and cluster are created, bookstores are established and connections are prepared. A Python notebook removes responses to an X post and gets his feeling scores with OCI Language. The results move from panda to an Apache Spark Dataprame and are stored in a Delta table. The categories and field toxicity_score of the notebook are computed by rules about negative feeling score. have an indicative range. Autonomous is later registered as an external catalogue and data are charged using MERGE by response identifier. The notebook is organized into a job with execution logs and an automatic program. At the end, Agent Factory connects to the database to answer questions about comments in natural language. The responses are contrasted with SQL consultations to follow the path from extraction to concurrently consultation.

From a template, we review the prompt, select the LLM and we have tested a flow that generates a blog article from the contents of a PDF. We then compare the result with the original document to review how you use the input information.

The Horizonte Operator's Case
Defend a regulated data product and evaluate your proposal with a rudder.

segments.title: The Horizonite Operator's Case · Acceptance Criteria and Closing
segments.text:
The Horizonte Operator's Case
Acceptance and Closing criteria
How to evaluate a proposal
Assign from zero to two points to each criterion: zero if missing, one if mentioned and two if explain with a verifiable example.
Criterion
Evidence of a complete response
Responsibility
Owner and steward identified and derogations with monitoring
Meaning
Entities, aim, validity and grain consistent with examples and indicators
Protection
Reportable actual accesses II and document treatment by context
Reliability
Rules, quarantine, freshness, recovery and impact of changes with evidence
Feasibility
Applicable controls, verified requirements and assigned expenditure
A pedagogical goal is eight of ten points, without omitting protection and liability. That's not an official certification threshold. Repeat the explanation with a change: a client revoks marketing while maintaining an existing contract. You have to be able to show what use changes, what operation continues and what evidence both decisions will prove.
He goes back to the sections of the course if some criterion of the heading remains unjustifiable. The closure of the workshop is the ability to uphold and revise a proposal and not the memorization of a list of products.

For every flow, you ask: who's production, who's consumption, what's his goal? What's the maximum latency of an update allowed? What's his name? What's his name about changing his scheme? It adds residence, volume, recovery and cost requirements as necessary. A liability-expressed master's limit a network boundary expressed connectivity. They're not equivalent.
Federar allows you to consult a source with a connection, avoiding a prior load at the destination for that access. It concurrently relies on availability, performance and permissions from the source. Meterializer creates a persistent result useful for performance, history or decoupling but requires to manage upgrade and life cycle. Sharing grants access to a published package under conditions: it does not eliminate recipient liability.

An organisation defines observable service targets. For Horizon it may matter that bills from the previous day are published before 08:00, that the result of reconciliation be known and that consumers see the latest update. They are targets of the case, and they are not preset guarantees of Oracle.

segments.title: Data Government
segments.text:
Data Government
Define authority, responsibilities, policies and evidence for using data.
The data government lays down who can decide about data, with what criteria and how it will be held accountable. Data management implements these decisions: model, integrate, protect, maintain and improve. One organization needs both. A committee that never changes a practice contributes little. an efficient platform with no shared criteria can multiply errors.
The data has value within a purpose. The same invoice record can serve as reconciliation, care or prediction of abandonment, but each use requires an appropriate justification, quality definition and accessibility. That's why it's not enough to declare that "data belong to all." A domain, its officials and authorized consumers should be recognised.
Three levels: governance, management and value

segments.title: Data's Government · Decisions, Reels and Evidence
segments.text:
Data Government
Decisions, Reels and Evidence
The owner data responded by domain decisions: meaning, accepted uses and priorities. The steward data coordinates definitions, quality problems and daily arrangements. The technical care implements controls and operations. A consumer meets conditions of use and challenges. Those are responsibilities. A small company can put several together in a person, documenting potential conflicts.
In the RACI matrix, rows are tasks and columns are roles. The letters indicate the responsibility of each role in each task: A responds by decision, R runs, C is consulted and I receives information. A role can have different letters depending on the line. In this example, steward runs when defining use (R) and is consulted when applying permissions (C). The custodian performs this last task (R). The owner responded by decision (A) in the four rows.
To approve the definition of "active client," commercial and financial can provide criteria. The designated owner decides for the agreed purpose. The catalogue manager publishes the approved definition but his technical permission does not make him the master of the meaning.
A useful policy contains scope, rule, owner, exceptions and evidence. "authorized personnel only" is insufficient without an authorisation criterion. "Domain analysts can consult aggregated bills for planning with quarterly access review" can be translated into controls. Frequency is an example of Horizon, not a universal demand.
4 Tasks and 4 Responsibilities Matrix

Three levels: governance, management and value
The base represents the government: The domain owner decides and responds to its permitted uses. Management converts these decisions into modeling, integration, protection and operation tasks, coordinated by the steward and the custodian. Key Concepts
The master data describe shared entities: client, product or supplier. The reference data deletes agreed values, such as contract states or document types. Transactions have events: an invoice, a payment or a contractual modification. Linkage an invoice with a client does not turn the invoice into master data.
The identity should be stable and have a clear scope. The identifier using Sales may differ from that of Filling. A matching table preserves that relationship. The authorized source can also be replaced by an attribute: a commercial address does not necessarily have the same authority as a verified identification.

Decision exercise
Two clients share name, address and phone, but their verified identifications are different. Marketing requests to join them to reduce duplication. He decides how to deal with his candidacy, what evidence to preserve and who resolves his disagreement. Consider what would happen with bills and conjunctions.
 
 Solution 

Keep identities separate: different identities are important evidence against fusion. The steward document the rejected candidacy and the owner of Clients resolves applicable policy. No invoices and no conjunctions are combined as a result of a campaign. A home relationship can be modeled if necessary and authorized, without deleting individual identities.

Identity, Correspondency and Survival
Match identifies candidates who could represent the same entity. Merge combines accepted logs. The survival rules determine what values and relationships survive. A high similarity score does not prove an identity: it should be interpreted with the available identifiers and the cost of an wrong union.
Horizonte defines matching rules, thresholds and cases that require review. The owner Clients approve of the policy. The steward looks at ambiguities. applications retain the original identifiers and traceability. A consolidated registry needs to explain from what source each attribute proceeds and what rule it chose.
Coincidence Propones and Evidence Decides
For reference data, the risk may be different: a code valid for a system does not have to be valid for another period or market. The lists require owner, definition, effective date and mapping. Retiring "suspended" to "inactive" without agreeing its meaning can alter care's indicators and decisions.

segments.title: Metadata Management · Decision Exercise
segments.text:
Metadata management
Decision exercise
Audit wants to rebuild the transformation that was used three months ago. The lineage view of Oracle AI Data Platform shows the last capture and the notebook changed several times. Decide what evidence of that execution should gather Horizonte to explain the historic result.
 
 Solution 

The current vision helps to understand dependencies but does not prove historic transformation. The notebook, execution identifier, relevant inputs and outputs, current rules and preserved evidence are required for that period. The technical owner brings these artifacts together. The owner confirms the currently applicable definition. If evidence lacks, the limitation is registered without rebuilding as if it had been captured.

Understanding artificial intelligence
Key concepts
Artificial Intelligence (AI) is the field that builds systems capable of performing tasks associated with perception, reasoning, language or decision. Machine Learning (ML) learns patterns from data. Deep Learning (DL) is a family of ML that uses multi-layered neural networks to learn complex representations. Thus, DL's inside ML and ML's inside AI.
The Generative AI produces text, images, audio or code. Many today's generating systems have been using deep learning. It doesn't mean they generate without predicting: a LLM can build text by predicting successive tokens. A profound network that classifies photographs remains DL even if it doesn't generate images.
Relationship between artificial intelligence, automatic and profound learning.
A solution specialized in transcribing calls does not prove general intelligence. AGI describes a broad overall capacity To recognize objects, by itself, doesn't credit them. It is also useful to separate AI from data science, including exploring data, designing experiments and communicating results with or without ML models.

MLP and convolutional networks
A Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) connects layers of neurons and can learn nonlinear boundaries. In the demonstration of concentric circles, a line does not separate the inner circle from the outside. To add capacity and activations allows a more suitable border The result should be checked at new points.
A Revolutionary Neural Network (CNN) takes advantage of local patterns and shares filters across different positions. A kernel goes through regions of the image and produces a feature map. The first layers can respond to edges and textures. Others combine more complex patterns.
Stages from an CNN: local filters, activation and space reduction before grading.
ReLU introduces nonlinearity. Pooling reduces space dimensions does not replace filter training. Final capes combine the characteristics to classify. Softmax converts scores into a class distribution. Dropout randomly deactivates some of the units while training to regularize; doesn't mean permanently eliminating data.
A CNN can be part of classification, detection or segmentation. Classifying identifies categories, detecting adds location and segmenting assigns tags per pixel. They're not equivalent outlays.

A RNN processes ordered steps and keeps an hidden state. The result of one step has an influence on the next. A complete review that produces a feeling label is many-to-one. an entry that generates a musical sequence, once and for many. translation between sequences, many-to-many.
Comparison of RNN with recurrent state and LSTM with memory regulated by gates.
Simple RNN can have difficulties with long dependencies, among other reasons for gradient that fade while training. LSTM adds state cell and entrance gates, oblivion and exit. They regulate new, retained and exposed information. It helps to preserve context but doesn't guarantee to remember any length.
Other models solve different goals: autoencoders learn how to rebuild inputs by means of a representation. GAN face generators and discriminators. The transformers use care and are studied in the following module. Not all networks are trained exclusively with human labels.

The model propose the following step. a tool gets data or runs an operation; The runtime coordinates decisions and results. memory retains relevant context. A chatbot can answer without acting and a workflow can follow a fixed sequence. An agent decides some of his steps dynamically.
Target cycle, decision, tool and agent result.
The platform is referred to as three groups: models to infer; agents to coordinate actions; and governance to control access, conduct and operation. Using a managed runtime reduces operational work but does not remove your responsibility for permissions, tools or response quality.

From tokens to useful responses
Key concepts
A Large Language Model (LLM) models language patterns. In an autoregressive generation, it takes context, gets scores for the potential tokens, selects one and adds them to the context to continue. It ends with an output condition, as an end token or a length limit.
A token can be a word, part of a word or sign. tokenization depends on model and language. To count words doesn't mean to count tokens. The vocabulary does not disappear and is reconstructed in every sentence: the context modifies the probabilities of its elements.
Context cycle, tokens distribution and selection of the following token.
Parameters are learned values, as weights. The tokens are input or output units, and are not parameters. The context window limits what an invocation can consider. The model size, numerical accuracy and context length have an impact on resources; more parameters do not best guarantee a better result in your task.

Propting, RAG and fine-tuning
A clear prompt specifies task, context, restrictions and expected format. Zero- shot doesn't give examples. Few-shot incorporates some. Learning in context conditions the response without changing weights. To demand a brief and verifiable explanation makes it easier to revise an outcome. does not give guaranteed access to internal reasoning or prove truthfulness.
Training tuning trains with instructions and responses to improve monitoring of tasks. RLHF uses human feedback to align conduct doesn't mean editing a prompt at every call.
Three customization routes: instructions, context recovery and model adjustment.
RAG regains relevant fragments, incorporates them into the context and generates a response supported by them. It's useful for private policies or information that changes. Fine-tuning adapts a pre-trained model with examples, for example for a dedicated task or style. It can set all weights or a part of the mandateable parameters. It's not an automatic substitute for viewing current data.
It starts with a simple appraisal and prompt. It improves recovery if evidence lacks and considers fine-tuning if a behavioral problem remains that the examples and instructions do not solve. They can be combined. No obligation to use them all.

A simple linear regression calculates prediction = w × x + b. The weight w changes the slope and bias b moves the straight. The loss function measures the error. The training looks for parameters that reduce them. A quadratic loss penalizes bigger mistakes.
The logistic regression, despite its name, serves as a classification. In its binary version, a sigmoide transformed a score into a value between 0 and 1. A threshold turns that value into a decision. The appropriate threshold depends on the cost of false positive and false negative That's not a 0,5 law.

Accuracy is good and case-divided but can be fooled with unbalanced classes. If 98's 100 equipment is healthy, always answer "healthy" and reach 98% and detects zero faults. Precision responded how many warnings were correct. recall, how many real mistakes you found. F1 combines both. Overfitting means that we have been too close to the examples we have seen and we have been bad at generalizing.

Pay As You Go links payment to measured consumption without a dedicated consumption exchange of that model. A Universal Credits agreement incorporates commitment and contractual terms. BYOL (Bring Your Own License) allows you to use eligible existing licenses under your conditions. Key concepts
The cloud allows to supply resources by demand with console, API or tools. Scalability is the capacity to increase or reduce resources; elasticity means matching them with demand. At IaaS you manage, among other things, your VMs operating system and the application. In PaaS services, Oracle manages more components of the platform. At SaaS, you have a complete application. The more the service is run, the more tasks are distributed. The responsibility for data and access remains vital.
