segments.name: 57bb515eddebb9ec205099dcb3b4e2e70518469589c36cc80464574c06cb6221-0000.txt
segments.title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations · Practice: ocif-compute-01
segments.text:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations
One application needs Linux and some CPU and memory capacity. What pieces should you have with them while throwing the VM?
Wrong choice: Shape for IAM users and group for CPU.
Explanation: The shape doesn't create identities and the group doesn't assign hardware.
Incorrect choice: The name of the instance as the only necessary parameter.
Explanation: The name does not specify system, capacity, network or access.
Answer correct: Image for initial and shape software for resources's compute.
Explanation: The image and capacity have to be supported, including processor architecture.
Wrong choice: Image for share and budget for the operating system.
Explanation: Those elements do not define share and system respectively.

segments.name: 5a76e11d219945bdfbe3c3a9da2b0f6e2faf0f2523447f59886b933f4bd90658-0000.txt
segments.title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations · Practice: ocif-compute-02
segments.text:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations
The campaign requires a shift from two to five application servers. What kind of climbing is that?
Correct Answer: Horizontal: changes the number of instances.
Explanation: Add Input Expands The Set require traffic distribution and manage state.
Wrong option: Vertical: necessarily changes memory of the same VM.
Explanation: The case modifies the number of servers, rather than the size of one.
Wrong choice: Live Migration: creates 3 new regions.
Explanation: Live Migration changes physical host of a compatible VM Do not create regions.
Wrong option: Online Resizing: Expands the file system.
Explanation: That concept corresponds to volume capacity, not to the number of VMs.

segments.name: bb2d587d1db2e0dd299d2654cf3f439e7cacdb526852168db2efb11952187a0f-0000.txt
segments.title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations · Practice: ocif-compute-03
segments.text:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations
What relationship correctly describes an instance configuration and an instance pool?
Wrong choice: Both are Security Lists names.
Explanation: They are administration components of Compute.
Wrong choice: The pool contains only users that can login.
Explanation: The users are administered with IAM, as members of an instance pool.
Answer correct: The configuration keeps launch parameters; The pool manages a set of instances.
Explanation: They are a parameter template and resources administered from a configuration.
Wrong choice: The configuration saves all orders and the pool is your backup.
Explanation: Do not replace the storage and back up application data.

segments.name: 2837e6806331cd5e23fd53f82d5dc603abf7800ad16513cb57b3a0434ea90a10-0000.txt
segments.title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations · Practice: ocif-compute-04
segments.text:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations
The team wants to run an container without operating an Kubernetes cluster. What service should we first evaluate?
Answer correct: Container Instances.
Explanation: It allows to run containers without managing a Kubernetes cluster for that purpose.
Wrong choice: OKE required, because all container requires Kubernetes.
Explanation: containers do not require an orchestrator Kubernetes.
Wrong choice: A Load Balancer as an container run.
Explanation: Distributes traffic Do not run the container process.
Wrong choice: A domain identity as an application server.
Explanation: The domain manages identities, doesn't run the workload.

segments.name: 45df88446b0fa7c9b10e4e1039e972a5dea71617331c4e8c69191ae7c46c93b8-0000.txt
segments.title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations · Practice: ocif-compute-05
segments.text:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations
Each new object should trigger a brief transformation of image. What choice does an event have?
Wrong choice: A table routing that reads and modifies the object.
Explanation: The table directs traffic, does not transform files.
Wrong choice: A VM required for every photo stored.
Explanation: The requirement does not require an individual VM to be administered by an object.
Answer correct: Functions invoked by integrating appropriate events.
Explanation: Your model fits with scattering executions fired by calls or events.
Wrong choice: A quote of storage as a code executor.
Explanation: The quota limits resources, does not process images.

segments.name: f36e0426b970ccbb2b2ebbb60bd0e6ab5d03b9101ee4384c8e9d106b5db03858-0000.txt
segments.title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations · Practice: ocif-compute-06
segments.text:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations
What statement about Live Migration is correct?
Answer correct: Can move a VM compatible with physical hosts while functioning with a short pause.
Explanation: you have to review eligibility doesn't promise a universal absence of interruptions.
Wrong choice: Always move any VM to another region without preparing data.
Explanation: It's not a universal regional migration mechanism.
Wrong choice: It's synonymous with increasing the number of instances of pool.
Explanation: To change physical host does not amount to climbing horizontally.
Wrong choice: Eliminates the need to design high availability.
Explanation: The maintenance of an VM does not cover all faults and dependencies.

segments.name: c6c494eeb30b7034b9fce1a9a8caed1d32f2c54c4acf0b2fa5dafdb9f5955c9a-0000.txt
segments.title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations · Practice: ocif-governance-01
segments.text:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations
The expenditure reached the budget threshold and an alert was sent. What necessarily happened with the VMs?
Answer correct: Nothing means they have been stopped: the budget is an information threshold.
Explanation: The alert does not constitute an automatic shutdown.
Wrong choice: All have been completed at once.
Explanation: Budgets does not automatically remove resources by crossing the threshold.
Wrong choice: Your share increased to compensate for your spending.
Explanation: A monetary alert does not change quotas.
Wrong choice: They moved automatically into another compartment.
Explanation: The budget does not move resources.

segments.name: 795a00e36cdd24143ddba2d5b8c752edfe4d88a0bb14fa26a8064cc5a614fae2-0000.txt
segments.title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations · Practice: ocif-governance-02
segments.text:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations
Development should consume at best some quantity of a resource. What's the manager's mechanism matching?
Wrong choice: A quantity tag = 4 without quota policy.
Explanation: The label alone does not impose that limit.
Wrong choice: A service limit increase as a single restriction.
Explanation: To increase the ceiling does not impose a minor maximum on Development.
Answer correct: A matching cutia compatible with service boundaries.
Explanation: It allows to list quantity of resources in the compartments.
Wrong choice: A budget used as a number of instances limit.
Explanation: The budget follows money and alerts, not that amount.

segments.name: 7d8f368888da646ee338bcd99ce78748317b4e1e8edc81b0ba503714538055e6-0000.txt
segments.title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations · Practice: ocif-governance-03
segments.text:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations
The expenditure went up and the team wants to compare it by service and period. What's his tool?
Answer correct: Cost Analysis.
Explanation: It allows to visualise and divide expenditure according to dimensions of analysis.
Wrong choice: Security Zones.
Explanation: Denies operations incompatible with security policies.
Wrong choice: A health check of the balancing machine.
Explanation: Check availability of backends, no financial breakdown.
Wrong choice: A Vault key.
Explanation: It protects data or secrets. It does not itself generate an analysis of expenditure.

segments.name: 26b7e8a855e65677028f641e2edb954dc8bc1be8a0360f7dd1f39135b480e74c-0000.txt
segments.title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations · Practice: ocif-governance-04
segments.text:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations
One application uses Compute, Object Storage and a rocker. You have to assign his consumption to the same project. What practice does that help?
Wrong choice: To expect that your IP's closeness will automatically determine your project.
Explanation: Network topology does not necessarily represent financial attribution.
Wrong choice: Using passwords as label values.
Explanation: The labels are not the place to store secrets.
Answer correct: Apply consistent project labels and configure appropriate cost monitoring.
Explanation: The labels can gather resources from different services to analyze consumption.
Wrong option: To give all resources the same OCID.
Explanation: OCID identify resources in a unique way. they are not re-used as a project label.

segments.name: 978cc8f51848a3e72763f64669fda378a87a9876ef3290336b149d330f7109a6-0000.txt
segments.title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations · Practice: ocif-governance-05
segments.text:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations
A company has eligible licenses and wants to use them at OCI. What concept should be revised?
Answer correct: BYOL and its eligible conditions.
Explanation: It allows to use eligible existing licences for applicable services and conditions.
Wrong option: Budget as a license transfer mechanism.
Explanation: Budgets defines spending thresholds and alerts.
Wrong option: Auto-Tiering as license conversion.
Explanation: Auto-Tiering manages objects levels.
Wrong option: Support Rewards as free new license guarantee.
Explanation: The benefits of support do not amount to that guarantee.

segments.name: d9aa79a76c20ea642c5cd816131c0a3cadb32d7ee4156c5df0937d7580d5c54e-0000.txt
segments.title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations · Practice: ocif-governance-06
segments.text:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations
Cloud Advisor recommends tipping an underused VM. What should the equipment do before they get rid of it?
Wrong choice: Unclear all spending alerts.
Explanation: Do not solve unnecessary consumption or evaluate dependencies.
Wrong choice: To assume that stopping them also removes all associated costs.
Explanation: Volumes and other resources can continue to generate consumption.
Answer correct: Check your function, peaks and dependencies and validate an appropriate action.
Explanation: The recommendation indicates a decision that should respect actual needs.
Wrong choice: To remove it without review as a recommendation is always authorized.
Explanation: It could stop a necessary function or destroy data if acted without checking.

segments.name: e52c3c388e7b107dea1f895181e6fa33cf66fa259131bc79fdf442dc45636175-0000.txt
segments.title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations · Practice: ocif-iam-01
segments.text:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations
Ana outweighs MFA but receives a denial as she tries to end an instance. What's the most direct explanation?
Wrong choice: The compartments have to be in another region to accept MFA.
Explanation: A compartments isn't a regional authentication mechanism.
Wrong choice: The SSH key replaces console IAM policies.
Explanation: SSH authenticates access to the operating system, does not authorize the end API.
Answer correct: The authentication was successful but lacks authorization for that operation.
Explanation: To check and allow an action are different checks.
Failed choice: MFA always allows to manage all instances.
Explanation: MFA adds verification, No permissions about resources.

segments.name: 45d992c0205ef57aef80642f75ded4d42eceaf25846d024990efb23d6da7cd9e-0000.txt
segments.title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations · Practice: ocif-iam-02
segments.text:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations
A manager can create users in a domain but cannot manage production networks. What's to be revised?
Answer right: The politics OCI authorising his group to discuss resources production.
Explanation: The role of the domain does not by itself involve administration of all resources OCI.
Wrong choice: The color and name of the domain on the console.
Explanation: The presentation doesn't determine permissions.
Wrong choice: If you created a public picket for that domain.
Explanation: A public picket does not give network management.
Wrong choice: If the group contains at least ten users.
Explanation: The size of the group does not give permissions; That's what applicable policies do.

segments.name: 0a4b8e8a0791c86fe55c86d72df59e93289f88600436a44ed74fb43cdba40668-0000.txt
segments.title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations · Practice: ocif-iam-03
segments.text:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations
What does «in compartment Produccion» express in a policy for reading instances?
Wrong choice: The shape that will get all the instances.
Explanation: The capacity is chosen when creating or amending instances, but not with that clause.
Wrong choice: A cryptographic key to decipher volumes.
Explanation: The compartment does not replace a Vault key.
Answer The area where access to information and information are granted resources.
Explanation: The location limits where the authorisation is applied.
Wrong choice: The authentication method to be used by the person.
Explanation: The sphere does not determine whether to use password, federation or MFA.

segments.name: 9266ef19b71e2e5ed8e24d946c8aecd10b210c3444c5ac5e687b3b1096ceb32d-0000.txt
segments.title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations · Practice: ocif-iam-04
segments.text:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations
An application at an instance needs to read private objects without saving an employee's password. What's his design?
Answer right: resource identity, appropriate dynamic group and tied reading policy.
Explanation: The resource acts as its main. The necessary operations are authorized by the policy.
Wrong option: Copy the administrator's password into image's VM.
Explanation: Connects the application to personal credentials and distributes an unnecessary secret.
Wrong choice: To public all the picket to avoid IAM.
Explanation: I would put forward data rather than give specific access to the application.
Wrong choice: To create a dynamic group with no policies.
Explanation: The rule selects members but does not give permissions itself.

segments.name: 05bdbb5b5295b9fa6eeb476b40aca1cff3e3f8f9e158c0fa9ec8cd7add124d94-0000.txt
segments.title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations · Practice: ocif-iam-05
segments.text:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations
A team only needs to consult production instances. What best approach does minimum privilege best apply?
Wrong choice: To add equipment to a group without revising its inherited policies.
Explanation: It may have no access or inherited permissions far too widely.
Wrong choice: To share the tenancy management account.
Explanation: Reduces traceability and grants privileges that the computer doesn't need.
Answer correct: To give reading to production group and to check actions allowed and refused.
Explanation: Accomplish function and scope and check that the restriction will have effect.
Wrong choice: To give management all-resources in tenancy to avoid mistakes.
Explanation: It gives more operations and scope than required.

segments.name: dc57ebac8b5d95efe06441c90d74ca6753deffeba09612fca1578a16ff6635a2-0000.txt
segments.title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations · Practice: ocif-iam-06
segments.text:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations
An operator has IAM authorisation and cannot connect SSH to a private VM. What have you to check as well?
Answer right: Access path, network rules, SSH service and system user key.
Explanation: IAM does not replace connectivity or authentication of the operating system.
Incorrect choice: That the VM budget exceed some amount.
Explanation: The budget does not allow SSH.
Wrong choice: That your IAM group have exactly the name of the VM.
Explanation: No general condition exists to authenticate SSH.
Wrong choice: That backup picket uses Archive.
Explanation: The backup level does not determine the current SSH connection.

segments.name: a2ee40b362b064b1a11dc8e50ce4ea781fb7c2abd4431dfeb9c0b6861e5d72bb-0000.txt
segments.title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations · Practice: ocif-networking-01
segments.text:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations
A private VM should download public packages without accepting connections initiated from the internet. What's his path?
Correct Answer: A path to NAT Gateway with necessary rules.
Explanation: NAT allows an output from the private network and its responses.
Wrong choice: Service Gateway for any web site.
Explanation: That gateway is intended for Oracle compatible services, and not for arbitrary locations.
Wrong choice: Just a Security List with all open ports.
Expand: To allow traffic does not create a path or translate addresses.
Wrong choice: A DRG without a configured connection to another network.
Explanation: The DRG connects networks as designed. by itself does not provide that public exit.

segments.name: 4ce5c4b9eedf7d931b00582ac18d478eb20cc4586bead36fc174ff7502e75c00-0000.txt
segments.title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations · Practice: ocif-networking-02
segments.text:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations
The application should have access to Object Storage from your region without crossing the internet. What component do you have to evaluate?
Wrong choice: A public address required for each VM.
Explanation: No requirement for Service Gateway access.
Wrong choice: A cutia for the picket.
Explanation: The quota controls quantity, not the network path.
Answer correct: Service Gateway and path to supported services.
Explanation: Provides this private path permissions objects are still necessary.
Wrong choice: Internet Gateway as the only possible mechanism.
Explanation: There's a private path using Service Gateway for supported services.

segments.name: 9b3095057b9ff9ec83a8a3872ecf22eef5b370951cbcdedde859fb912f45819f-0000.txt
segments.title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations · Practice: ocif-networking-03
segments.text:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations
Several servers from the same subnetwork have different functions. That's what we're talking about. VNIC and enforcement. What grouping does that match?
Answer That's right: A Network Security Group for those VNIC.
Explanation: A NSG allows to group by function the resources compatible.
Wrong choice: A Security List that stop affecting the other VNIC from that subnet.
Explanation: The lists of the subnetwork apply to their VNIC; They don't select that subset only.
Wrong choice: A table routing used as a list of authorized users.
Explanation: The routes are neither identity policies nor port filters.
Wrong choice: A compartments with the same port name.
Explanation: an organisational name does not define traffic rules.

segments.name: c145a231b69174c06d546681bfcf12ae8b395f95c0b9126ab809028b5506da12-0000.txt
segments.title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations · Practice: ocif-networking-04
segments.text:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations
A VM is Running, but his backend misses health check. What interpretation should the equipment do?
Wrong choice: Health checks only serve billing.
Explanation: They are used to evaluate backend availability.
Wrong choice: Any authentication should be removed from the site immediately.
Explanation: It isn't a well-founded response to health failure and can weaken the application.
Answer right: The process or its connectivity can fail even if the VM is activated.
Explanation: We have to review application, port and rules. state of VM does not prove service health.
Wrong choice: The scorer should send traffic because Running guarantees healthy HTTP.
Explanation: state compute does not replace the application check.

segments.name: e3dafd327b0b19e47e668c0e87334dfdecb0cbbae96eb26334f0b0966c6e70fb-0000.txt
segments.title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations · Practice: ocif-networking-05
segments.text:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations
Two backends use Round Robin with 1 and 3 weights. What about an approximate distribution do you expect while both are healthy and without other factors?
Answer: One in every four requests to first and three to second.
Explanation: relative weights modify the expected share they do not force a 50/50.
Wrong choice: The exact half to each because the weights aren't supported.
Explanation: Load Balancer supports pesos Round Robin can distribute weighted.
Wrong choice: All backend requests with 1 weight.
Explanation: The minor weight does not make it an exclusive destination.
Wrong choice: The backend with 3 weight becomes a public IP.
Explanation: The weight affects distribution, non-visibility of network.

segments.name: 2289e95c604b0432c8351970ac39924a922c23fc0347eee2a7daf0d0258f45ac-0000.txt
segments.title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations · Practice: ocif-networking-06
segments.text:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations
The shop's web should be public but its servers should stay private. What design makes sense?
Wrong choice: Using NAT as an input HTTPS list.
Explanation: NAT does not publish the service for new internet connections.
Wrong choice: To remove health checks so that private backends are accessible.
Explanation: Health does not replace connectivity and remains necessary to balance correctly.
Answer correct: Public biker and private backend with appropriate rules and routes.
Explanation: The public front can get customers and distribute them to private servers.
Wrong choice: To assign a public IP to each backend.
Explanation: It isn't necessary for the balancing machine to get to private backends.

segments.name: c1a9193581898b9cf5a7e6e9e4cf3baadc516b93219d2c5dc3c03e4721ae26e7-0000.txt
segments.title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations · Practice: ocif-oci-architecture-01
segments.text:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations
A region has a single AD. The store wants to reduce the impact of maintenance of a hardware group on its two VMs. What decision does it help directly?
Answer right: place VMs in different Fault Domains.
Explanation: FDs separate hardware groups within AD The AD remains a shared area.
Wrong choice: To create another compartments and preserve both VMs in the same FD.
Explanation: The compartment changes organization and permissions, not physical separation.
Wrong choice: To change only the name of the instances.
Explanation: The name doesn't change the hardware where they run.
Wrong choice: To increase tenancy's budget.
Explanation: A financial threshold does not change the placement of resources.

segments.name: 3c56e2932d00d53e4745d70ff96138355837187b2c0c38e9f0890d8a063eafa0-0000.txt
segments.title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations · Practice: ocif-oci-architecture-02
segments.text:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations
The users have delays because the application is far from clear. When evaluating another region, what criterion should be followed by proximity?
Wrong choice: To choose only by the name most similar to that of the project.
Explanation: The name does not meet technical or residence requirements.
Wrong choice: Double the compartments in today's region.
Explanation: The compartment does not physically approach the application to its users.
Answer correct: Check data residence, service availability and capacity.
Explanation: The closeness can reduce latency but should also meet the restrictions of the case.
Wrong choice: To assume that all regions have the same AD and free capacity.
Explanation: The regional structure and available capacity may vary.

segments.name: be47241b4b93179cce61ab25dc5fd1396f5315f803b75b5b04f529705067ceb4-0000.txt
segments.title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations · Practice: ocif-oci-architecture-03
segments.text:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations
A operator doesn't find an VM that another member created. What's the first sensible diagnosis?
Answer correct: Check tenancy, region, compartments and permissions.
Explanation: Those coordinates and access determine what resources can track down.
Wrong option: To create an immediate second VM.
Explanation: Can double a resource that already exists without solving the problem of context.
Wrong choice: To assume that the resource was deleted because the list is empty.
Explanation: An empty list may also be due to region, compartments or permissions.
Wrong choice: Convert the project's picket to public.
Explanation: The visibility of a picket does not determine the list of instances.

segments.name: 390ad5db98a027e3f3dde0d450e204cc72a4a2b52f05373e5d4789b933d1f701-0000.txt
segments.title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations · Practice: ocif-oci-architecture-04
segments.text:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations
A VM can be manually expanded but keeps the same capacity for weeks of low demand. What distinction does the case explain?
Wrong choice: Pay As You Go guarantees that an idle VM consumes nothing.
Explanation: The supplied capacity can still be invoiced.
Wrong choice: Scalability requires using exclusively Functions.
Explanation: The capacity can be adjusted with different services, also VMs.
Answer correct: It's scalable but isn't adjusting capacity elasticately to demand.
Explanation: To change size is different from effectively adapting capacity to use.
Wrong choice: It's elastic because its name can change.
Explanation: Rename does not adapt resources to demand.

segments.name: f46a4fde40e8fa3ba91b0fa9e6bed54716c9728fa6385d95b94605d96934fc29-0000.txt
segments.title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations · Practice: ocif-oci-architecture-05
segments.text:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations
An organisation needs an OCI region at its own data centre. What offer relates to that requirement?
Answer correct: OCI Dedicated Region.
Explanation: The offer takes an OCI region to the client's data centre under service conditions.
Wrong choice: Oracle Interconnect for Azure.
Explanation: Connects Oracle and Azure environments does not put a region at the centre of the client by itself.
Wrong choice: OCI Load Balancer.
Explanation: It distributes traffic but does not determine where a cloud region is installed.
Wrong choice: an additional identity domain.
Explanation: Organises identities does not deploy physical infrastructure.

segments.name: 2ada0a6e6a27827f8afa5c45bcecf204a85031da797668786e53f633f7853dcc-0000.txt
segments.title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations · Practice: ocif-oci-architecture-06
segments.text:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations
The store duplicated its VMs into two AD FDs but the whole application depends on a single data process. What conclusion's right?
Incorrect choice: FDs automatically replicate all application data.
Explanation: FD placement alone does not shape that replication.
Wrong choice: A new OCID for each VM resolves the dependence.
Explanation: Unique identifiers do not provide information about the data process.
Answer correct: Also check data availability and shared dependencies.
Explanation: Separate fronts does not remove other unique malfunction points.
Wrong choice: It already guarantees continuity with any regional loss.
Explanation: Both VMs are still at the same AD and have shared dependencies.

segments.name: 73111cdcb62a41c8f67c6ea85cc6b7eb051cb36823c5f243a807fd6e70671a87-0000.txt
segments.title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations · Practice: ocif-security-01
segments.text:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations
Who should set up an employee's access to the store's data and patch their VMs's guest system?
Wrong choice: The internet provider only.
Explanation: Transportation traffic does not manage the identities and guest system.
Wrong choice: No one, because the cloud removes those tasks.
Explanation: The tasks change distribution and do not disappear.
Answer correct: The client, within the responsibilities of the service used.
Explanation: At IaaS the client manages guest access, applications and operating system.
Wrong choice: Oracle automatically decides what employee can read each order.
Explanation: The supplier operates IAM but the client defines his accesses.

segments.name: 2aaaf00983d5071bf1ac068a45c4bdbb2263de30c5e834a0d64fece985b19896-0000.txt
segments.title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations · Practice: ocif-security-02
segments.text:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations
The requirement is to deny a public package that violates an established policy. What control directly relates?
Answer correct: Security Zones with a recipe to stop that operation.
Explanation: It can prevent operations that are in breach of policies applicable to them.
Wrong choice: Cost Analysis.
Explanation: Analyzes expenditure, does not valid that security configuration.
Wrong choice: Cloud Guard as a guarantee of preventive blocking of every operation.
Explanation: its role of detection and response does not amount to that preventive denial.

Cyfrar transforms legible text into cipher text using an algorithm and a key. Decipher recovers the content after compliance with cryptographic and access conditions. The symmetric encryption uses a shared key. the asymmetric, a pair of keys with related functions. A hash isn't just cipher that you can undo with a key.
A legible document is listed and transformed into protected data. The key has a separate flow from the document.
The resting encryption protects stored data. in transit protects their transport, for example by using TLS. Do not confuse anything with permission: a legitimately authorized user can get his or her deciphered data. A public cipher but exposed can continue to reveal information through the service.
OCI Vault manages keys and secrets. A cryptographic key is used for encryption operations; A secret can contain a password, token or other sensitive material. Separate them from the code prevents them from embedded into distributed configuration files. Key protection modes, such as software or HSM, and their options should be chosen according to service requirements.
A service can use keys administered by Oracle or a client-supported key. The latter gives additional monitoring of the life cycle with responsibilities about permissions, availability and disposal. Rotate a key and rotate a password are different processes. Query Key Management and Vault.

Auto-Tiering moves eligible objects between Standard and Invalid Access according to observed patterns. Do not move automatically to Archive. Object Lifecycle Management rules allow other transitions and actions as determined by conditions. They are not synonymous with Auto-Tiering. Query levels of storage.
Standard and Invalid Access are united both ways by Auto-Tiering; Archive has a separate path of lifecycle and restoration.
A private picket requires permission to have access. A pre-authored request (pAR) provides shortcut with a valid link: whoever owns that link can exercise the authorized access. A public visibility policy is a different decision. For internal data, have private access. Don't make an entire picket public to solve an app's access.
The console and OCI CLI allow them to create buckets and upload objects. At Cloud Shell you can check with the namespace with ocos ns get an outside CLI requires your authentication configuration. When uploading a file, it identifies picket, name and region, and verifies with the identity that should be consumed. Version retains versions; retention and lifecycle add different controls.

A Block Volume belongs to an AD and replies within it for durability. It does not by itself involve a usable copies in another region. Choose capacity and level of performance for IOPS's needs and throughout A large disc isn't automatically the solution to every bottle neck.
A volume is attached to an VM, appears as a device in the operating system and is assembled to be used by the application.
OCI presents the device with virtualization with a paraglided attachment. In iSCSI, the instance is connected to the volume using the appropriate protocol. The manual configuration or agent should complete the connection. That the console shows the attached doesn't prove that there's a built-up file system. Do not form a volume with data to solve a mounting problem.
Online Resizing allows to extend a connected volume. The OS may then have to re-detect the capacity and extend the partition or file system. It's not an operation to reduce it. Keep Resizing a Volume.
At File Storage it distinguishes file system, mount target and export. The system contains the archives; The destination gives network access. export and their options control how customers gain access. Configure NFS and, where applicable, cipher in transit.
